definition_en: two slices of bread with food between them, or to place something between two things

definition_en: not difficult, or free from worry
core_image: 一道简单的数学题写在纸上，旁边已经打了勾

senses.title: Not difficult
senses.definition: not hard to do or understand

senses.title: Each member
senses.definition: each one of a group, taken one by one
senses.example: Every child gets a book.
senses.exampleCN: 每个孩子都拿到一本书。
senses.why: Old English had æfre ælc, 'ever each'; the two words fused into one determiner that takes the members of a group one at a time.
senses.whyCN: 古英语有 æfre ælc，意为「每一个」，两个词合成一个限定词，表示把一组里的成员逐个算上。

senses.title: At fixed intervals
senses.definition: at intervals of a stated length
senses.example: The bus comes every ten minutes.
senses.exampleCN: 公交车每十分钟来一班。
senses.why: The 'each' idea applied to a stretch of time gives the interval sense: each ten-minute period brings one bus.
senses.whyCN: 把「每一个」用在时间段上就产生间隔义：每一个十分钟就有一班车。

senses.title: All possible
senses.definition: all the possible
senses.example: She has every reason to be proud.
senses.exampleCN: 她有充分的理由感到自豪。
senses.why: Because each single reason is counted, the word can stress that none is missing, and so it came to mean 'all possible'.
senses.whyCN: 因为连每一个理由都算上，这个词就能强调一个也不缺，于是有了「所有可能的」这一意思。

definition_en: to enjoy something, similar to, or such as
core_image: 两个孩子穿着一样的雨靴，踩在同一片水洼里
scene: 两个孩子穿着一样的雨靴，踩在同一片水洼里。 I like this book very much.
sceneCN: 这里 like 是「喜欢」（第 01 个义项）；句意是我很喜欢这本书。

senses.title: To enjoy something
senses.definition: To enjoy something
senses.example: I like this book very much.
senses.why: Old English lician meant to please; English turned it around so that the person became the subject who likes.
senses.whyCN: 古英语 lician 意为使人满意；英语把它反过来，让人成为喜欢的主语。

senses.title: Similar to
senses.definition: Similar to
senses.example: She sings like her mother.
senses.why: The preposition came from a different Old English word, gelic, meaning similar, and kept the sense of resemblance.
senses.whyCN: 介词来自另一个古英语词 gelic，意为相似，保留了相像的意思。

senses.title: Such as
senses.definition: Such as
senses.example: He enjoys fruit like apples and pears.
senses.exampleCN: 他喜欢苹果、梨这样的水果。
senses.why: Because a similar example stands for a class, like also introduces examples, as in fruit like apples.
senses.whyCN: 因为一个相似的例子可以代表一类，like 也用来举例，如 fruit like apples。
